spans.text: An intense shootout has broken out between two unknown armed parties inside a mansion in Berlin.
As the violent confrontation near the city center gradually spirals out of control, the police doesn't seem to have the capacity to respond to this latest emergency...
We will now hand over to Shadowless, our correspondent on site.
This is Shadowless, reporting live from outside the mansion in which a shootout recently took place.
As the police is completely occupied by the conflict in the city center, we can see that other than the emergency response team, there isn't a single police car here.
The response team has discovered six bodies at the scene, but the causes of death remain unknown...?
Oh, the response team has found...uh...a number of human body parts...?
They have reported no fewer than six casualties to their headquarters. The identities are yet to be confirmed.
We will catch up with you once we have more information, main station.
